live_only: on a slower runner the TypeScript daemon's 0.75 s frame-tree cache (plugins#92) runs out sooner, so after `back` it sends one Page.getFrameTree more than the recording has; replay matches it to the recording's later tree (taken after `forward`, at #/people/4), and the next `get url`, which reads the tracked URL, reports that. A real browser answers with the current tree, so the daemon is right; replay can't yet tell an extra probe from one it reached early
